svg.title: Set up a shared display
svg.desc: Install Player Switch, then save every player once: each signs in on Autodarts after Add account. On a display that shows the toolbar, pin the icon; in fullscreen or kiosk mode, players switch with the button on the Autodarts page or the keyboard shortcut. Let the computer start Chrome in kiosk mode by itself, give it an on-screen keyboard for the sign-ins, and keep the browser running, so that the renewal every 12 hours keeps every parked account ready.
